name: 摺疊後按尺寸收納
extended_definition: 摺疊符合尺寸規格，並放入對應收納區
distinguishing_example: 只在桌上摺好：父任務可滿足，但新增收納條件未滿足
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 掃集時限制非目標物位移
base_definition: 完成原掃集目標及原作限制
extended_definition: 為指定非目標物增加明確的整段位移上限
distinguishing_example: 掃集完成但非目標物超過新上限：原版是否接受依原作判分，新規格拒絕
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 取物後關回抽屜
base_definition: 達到指定抽屜開合程度
extended_definition: 開抽屜、取得指定物件、最後關回；加入必要事件順序
distinguishing_example: 最後抽屜關好但未取物：單一關閉任務可滿足，組合程序未完成
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 依接收容器餘量選擇分裝
base_definition: 轉移到指定連續物料目標
extended_definition: 先取得容器餘量；容量足夠時一次轉移，不足時依規則分裝
distinguishing_example: 達到總轉移量但任一容器超容：新增容量分支規則拒絕
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 按訂單打包後交付
base_definition: 來源分別提供打包與送達工作的起點
extended_definition: 按清單打包、保留載荷、送到指定交付點並完成確認
distinguishing_example: 打包正確但送錯交付點：打包子任務完成，組合任務未完成
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 按先前鄰接關係取回
base_definition: 根據原作歷史／鄰接規則選取物件
extended_definition: 加入明訂參考時刻與物件身份，移動後仍按該時刻關係選取
distinguishing_example: 選了目前鄰居而非參考時刻的鄰居：兩套指涉規則給出不同答案
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 拉直並保持端點在指定區
extended_definition: 加上兩端點區域與禁止跨越區；確認材料模型可支援後實作
distinguishing_example: 繩索拉直但端點位於區外：原拉直目標可滿足，擴充約束未滿足
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 接收確認後才釋放載荷
base_definition: 把物品送到指定交付位置
extended_definition: 加入接收方與可觀察接穩事件，之後才允許釋放
distinguishing_example: 物品到達但提前釋放：到達子目標可滿足，交接順序違反
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 偏離後完成装配並復原工具
extended_definition: 在記錄的中途偏離條件後完成裝配，並把使用工具放回指定狀態
distinguishing_example: 裝配成功但工具未復原：新增終態尚未全部完成
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 依最新有效訂單分揀並登記
base_definition: 依視覺／文字提示移動指定物件
extended_definition: 查詢有效訂單版本，完成對應放置後登記；物理與數位結果需一致
distinguishing_example: 依過期版本正確放置：舊提示可滿足，最新版本規格不接受
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 摺疊規格保持，增加觀測條件
extended_definition: 分別提供固定相機、多視角或可主動觀察條件；保留足夠線索
distinguishing_example: 這項擴充不宣稱新的物理目標；它形成不同的觀測測例
novelty_vs_prior_union: pending; equivalent existing rules must be linked rather than claimed new
scope: Example design, not a calibrated difficulty label or valid case count.

name: 從架子製作程序建立下一步判斷
base_definition: 來源提供製作架子的活動與步驟定義
extended_definition: 給定可用影片前綴／已完成步驟，判斷下一個合法程序步驟
